what_it_does: Large data centers contain thousands of servers and cooling systems, power supplies, and network switches that all interact in complex ways. When one component fails, the failure cascades through interconnected subsystems, making it extremely hard to identify the root cause. Existing monitoring tools watch for thresholds or correlations, but these miss hidden cause-effect chains buried in high-dimensional, constantly changing sensor data. PACE (Pattern and Causal Exploration) combines unsupervised pattern detection with causal inference (a statistical technique that discovers which signals actually cause others) to produce interpretable cause-and-effect graphs aligned with physical systems.
